issues: Both assets are pre-printed Kellogg engineering forms (Form No. ALDG-2-16) with handwritten entries; some hand-written numeric values are partially illegible at this raster resolution and may need higher-DPI re-OCR for verification (e.g., row entries for Sx, Sy, Sz under member F-1 in the y/z planes).
No standalone figures/photographs/diagrams are present on this page; both assets are tabular forms and have been emitted as kind='tbl'.

Table HTML in source markdown captures the form structure but contains some merged-cell/colspan irregularities reflecting the original printed grid; downstream consumers should treat the markdown HTML as authoritative for cell topology and the raster as authoritative for handwritten values.
